type.note: System fonts only; no proprietary game font is bundled.

geometry.cutout: clip-path polygon with intentionally varied corners
geometry.fold: one directional crease shadow with a bright paper ridge
geometry.edge: 2px ink or warm-gray outline plus a short paper-thickness shadow

motion.unfold: One short hinge or height change on confirmation.
motion.reducedMotion: Remove nonessential transforms and animated unfolding.
